slot.brief: Statements about components of photochemical smog (ozone, PAN, NO2); identify the correct combination.

stem: Which one of the following combinations contains chemical species that are characteristic components of photochemical smog?

verdicts.working: Photochemical smog characteristically contains O₃, PAN, and NO₂; only option (A) lists all three.

working:
Photochemical smog is formed by the action of sunlight on nitrogen oxides and hydrocarbons. Its characteristic components include ozone (O3), peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) and nitrogen dioxide (NO2). SO2, CH4 and CO2 are not the main characteristic products of photochemical smog.

Independent check: Photochemical smog characteristically contains O₃, PAN, and NO₂; only option (A) lists all three.
solution: Photochemical smog forms when sunlight acts on nitrogen oxides and hydrocarbons. Its characteristic components include $\mathrm{O_3}$, PAN, and $\mathrm{NO_2}$; only (A) lists all three.
